release_notes:
Snippets can now include other snippets (Pro): {{snippet:_sig}} types the current text of your _sig snippet, so a signature or disclaimer shared by many replies is edited in one place

Pick one from Insert variable › Another snippet…, and the live preview shows the full result. Included snippets can use variables and include others too

Change a trigger and the snippets that include it follow along; delete one and Snippets tells you which snippets use it

A missing snippet or an include loop shows a message instead of expanding, so a half-finished reply never lands in your document
